title: STDD project configuration
description: Schema for .stdd.config.yml. Declares project structure, commands, docs layout, workflow options, and plugins consumed by stdd skills and agents.

version.description: Config format version. Currently 1. Used for future migration of the config layout. Optional.

name.description: Short identifier for the project. Kebab-case recommended (e.g. 'my-app').

language.description: Preferred natural-language for skill / agent output. Currently only 'ja' and 'en' are supported by core skills; additional locales require new translations to be contributed.

apps.description: List of applications inside the repository. At least one app is required.

id.description: Short identifier used in docs paths and command substitution. Lowercase, may contain digits, underscore, or hyphen. Examples: 'web', 'admin', 'user_app'.

path.description: Filesystem path (relative to repo root) where this app's source lives. Examples: 'apps/web', 'user_app'.

port.description: Optional dev-server port for this app. Used by E2E config and worktree port allocation.

framework.description: Optional informational tag (e.g. 'nextjs', 'remix', 'sveltekit'). Plugins may key off this value.

commands.description: Commands stdd will execute on behalf of the project. Define them so skills do not need to hardcode tooling.

typecheck.description: Command that performs static type checking and exits 0 on success. Example: 'npx tsc --noEmit'.

test.description: Default test runner command. Example: 'npm test', 'pnpm test', 'vitest run'.

build.description: Production build command. Used by the pre-push hook and QA flow. Example: 'npm run build'. Optional.

db_reset.description: Command to reset the local database to a known seeded state. Optional.

db_types.description: Command to regenerate database-derived TypeScript / language types. Optional.

docs.description: Documentation layout used by spec / plan skills.

layout.description: Path templates that map an app + feature to its documentation files. Handlebars variables available: {{app.id}}, {{app.path}}, {{feature_path}}, {{date}}. {{app.*}} resolves against each entry of the top-level `apps[]`. Note: test file layout (e2e / integration / unit paths) is intentionally out of scope for this schema in Phase 1-A; templates currently assume conventional layouts and Phase 1-B may introduce a separate `tests.layout` object.

common_requirements.description: Optional path template for the project-wide (common tier) REQUIREMENTS.md — the whole-service business requirements overview. No app/feature variables apply. Example: 'docs/common/REQUIREMENTS.md'. Omit when the project does not use a common tier.

common_architecture.description: Optional path template for the project-wide (common tier) ARCHITECTURE.md — the whole-service technical design overview (the project-level counterpart of TECH_DESIGN.md). No app/feature variables apply. Example: 'docs/common/ARCHITECTURE.md'. Omit when the project does not use a common tier.

tech_design.description: Path template for TECH_DESIGN.md. Same variables as 'requirements'.

wireframes.description: Optional path template for the HTML wireframes directory generated by the generating-wireframes skill. Same variables as 'requirements'. Example: 'docs/{{app.id}}/{{feature_path}}/wireframes/'. When omitted, skills default to a 'wireframes/' directory next to REQUIREMENTS.md.

plan.description: Path template for PLAN documents. Additional variable: {{date}} (yyyy-mm-dd of the session).

workflow.description: Optional workflow toggles. Skills consult these to enable / disable worktree- and devcontainer-aware code paths.

branch_prefix.description: Prefix applied to branches created by stdd skills (e.g. 'claude/'). Skills read this instead of hardcoding a prefix. Optional; defaults to 'claude/'.

enabled.description: Whether the project uses git worktrees for parallel development.

script.description: Path to the project's worktree creation script. Required when 'enabled' is true.

port_base.description: Base port number used to derive per-worktree port offsets.

override_config.description: Path to a devcontainer override config used by the worktree flow.

plugins.description: Plugins loaded in addition to core skills/agents. Each entry may be a short string id or an object with options.

oneOf.description: Short plugin id. Resolves to npm package '@stdd/plugin-<id>' by convention.

id.description: Plugin id (same resolution rules as the string form).

options.description: Plugin-specific options. Validated by the plugin's own schema, not by this schema.
